meta.name: I - stock vault roles and handover to the Timelock
meta.description: Finishes the oracle-free NVDA long/flat vault in one atomic transaction. Grants KEEPER_ROLE and RISK_COUNCIL_ROLE to this Safe, grants VAULT_ROLE on the swap adapter to the vault, points the vault at that swap adapter, grants DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE to the Timelock, and renounces this Safe's own DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. KEEPER on the Safe rather than the Timelock is deliberate and is disclosed on the site: rebalanceTo is the manager's actual job and cannot wait 48 hours. RISK_COUNCIL likewise, because a circuit breaker that takes two days to pull is not a brake. Everything about the vault's CONFIGURATION, its fees, its roles, the venue it trades through, stays timelocked. ATOMIC ON PURPOSE: the renounce is last, and any other order leaves a step needing an admin the Safe has already given up. The vault must never sit in a state where it has an admin who is neither this Safe nor the Timelock. Deployed 6 September 2026: oracle 0xaBefb351777d8E68FCafa4D2F8A5848F326298cA, vault 0xB129495f0ad616EdD2f28b3B49470FC1f0FAD413, swap adapter 0x8E50FC336f87b454cc44a89dA3a7267412B045dc. NOTE: Safe nonces execute in order.
